messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT 612777 — Dedicated pool capacity alert for tenant `emberpeak` (enterprise VPC). GPU utilization 98%, queue growth. Paging SRE and EngRuntime.
Arjun Patel: oncall here, looking. Joining on Zoom. can someone paste graphs?
Blythe Chen: past 5m: GPU util 96-99%, queued tokens 2.1k, avg latency tail -> 600-1.2s. 503 rate ~5% for emberpeak-prod. logs: `OOM on model: redwood/gptx-13b-std` on 3 nodes.
EngRuntime Lead: noted. This is a single-tenant dedicated pool (48 GPUs) — looks fully saturated. Autoscale didn't add nodes: cloud quota hit (project quota 56 gpus). Burst policy for this tenant is `manual`.
Maya (Customer Ops): customer on the phone — seeing failed requests and timeouts in their UI. They've asked for ETA. They're sensitive (SLA). I told them we're investigating.
Arjun Patel: options: 1) request manual burst from shared pool (need infra approval), 2) failover traffic to smaller quantized model variant, 3) temporarily reduce concurrency/enable shedding for non-critical routes. Which do we want now?
EngRuntime Lead: start with 2 + 1 in parallel. Prepare to switch non-critical endpoints to `gptx-13b-q8` to free mem. I'll push a dynamic route override for traffic tagged `slimmer` and enable prefix KV cache trimming.
Blythe Chen: prepping a quick runbook snippet: ```
# route override
redwoodctl routes update emberpeak-prod --route /chat --model redwood/gptx-13b-q8 --concurrency 8
``` 
— this should drop memory and help throughput.
infra-approver: got the paging. I can grant burst from shared-pool-1 but need approval note. How many GPUs required?
EngRuntime Lead: request +8 GPUs for 30m as a safety net. CLI to call if approved: `redwoodctl capacity burst --tenant emberpeak --from shared-pool-1 --gpus 8 --duration 30m --reason \"prod saturation\"`
Arjun Patel: @infra-approver please approve asap. I'll throttle non-critical webhooks and set concurrency limits.
infra-approver: approved. kicking off burst now.
incident-bot: Action: `capacity.burst` started by infra-approver — 8 GPUs added from shared-pool-1 to emberpeak-dedicated (id: burst-612777). Timestamp 6127779200.
Blythe Chen: seeing new nodes registering. queue length dropping from 2100 -> 900 within 2m.
EngRuntime Lead: switching /analytics and /batch-infer to q8 now. command issued.
Maya (Customer Ops): told customer we enabled mitigations and added capacity, ETA ~5-10m to stabilize. They've acknowledged and will monitor.
Arjun Patel: monitoring perf: p50 120ms, p95 380ms, p99 860ms and falling. 503s trending down.
Blythe Chen: note: one node still shows occasional OOMs on long contexts >8k tokens, we should add a guard to reject >10k for now.
EngRuntime Lead: added guard: `max_context=10k` for emberpeak-prod, non-extendable until we confirm stability.
Arjun Patel: can we keep the burst for 30m and re-evaluate at +25m? I'll start an incident timeline and assign postmortem owners.
Maya (Customer Ops): creating support ticket and sending a short status update to account contacts now.
infra-approver: will start a short quota request with cloud for long-term increase; but that takes days. For now patching with burst and model quantization is fine.
Blythe Chen: recording mitigation steps and logs to incident channel. Tagging for postmortem: EngRuntime Lead, Arjun, Blythe, Maya.
incident-bot: NOTE: incident state -> mitigated (capacity added + model fallback). Please continue monitoring. If error rate > 1% for next 10m, escalate.
Arjun Patel: handoff: I'll stay for 20m then hand to next SRE oncall. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
Maya (Customer Ops): customer notified, they want a retro. I'll set up a post-call with account in 24h.
EngRuntime Lead: follow-up actions: 1) propose permanent quota bump or scheduled reserved burst for emberpeak, 2) add auto-fallback to q8 under high mem pressure, 3) improve autoscaler to surface quota failures as alerts.
Blythe Chen: capturing metrics snapshot and artifacts now. Last check: queue 120, util 65%, errors down to 0.8%.
Arjun Patel: closing live paging; handoff to postmortem owners. last_message_ts=6127780450
